# Standby Atlas

> Europe's data-centre pipeline from public filings: 172 upcoming data-centre projects in 14 countries, with IT and grid MW, backup generators, thermal input, engine makes, stage, date and a link to the official document for every record. Data as of 9 November 2026.

## Pages
- [All projects](https://standbyatlas.com/projects/): one page per project with its official source
- [Method and coverage](https://standbyatlas.com/method/): definitions, coverage by country, corrections
- [Free sample and data dictionary](https://standbyatlas.com/data/): 20 records as CSV
- [Report and licences](https://standbyatlas.com/pricing/): founding report, annual watch, team and resale licences
- [New filings feed](https://standbyatlas.com/feed.xml): Atom; feeds per engine make and per country at https://standbyatlas.com/alerts/
- [Free JSON API](https://standbyatlas.com/api/v1/projects.json): every project with free fields and its official source; OpenAPI at https://standbyatlas.com/api/openapi.json
- [MCP server](https://standbyatlas.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP, no sign-in; tools search_projects, latest_filings, pipeline_stats, search, fetch. How to connect: https://standbyatlas.com/api/

## Citation
Standby Atlas, European data-centre pipeline, data as of 9 November 2026, https://standbyatlas.com/
